before.summary: A camera roll full of clips. A blank timeline. A weekend gone.

points.0: Long pauses, false starts and the same line recorded several times
points.1: Clips in the order you shot them, not the order of the story
points.2: Captions, a cover picture and a post caption still to do

after.summary: A finished cut with the dead air gone, in the shape each channel wants.

points.0: Dead air, false starts and retakes removed, with every cut on a full sentence
points.1: Captions when you switch them on, and subtitle files to upload
points.2: Landscape, vertical, square or portrait, chosen before the run

drop.title: Drop in what you have
drop.description: Upload the clips you already shot. A few different shots make a better edit than one long take. Screen recordings and brand files work too, and software teams can connect their code.

say.title: Say what it is for
say.description: Pick a recipe, such as a highlight edit or a narrated story, and say in a sentence what the video is for and who will watch it.

review.title: Get a reviewed cut you can change
review.description: An AI video team cuts it and scores the draft before you see it. A low score sends it back for another pass. Then change a line, a clip or the whole cut in the editor.

team.title: A whole production team, on demand
team.description: An editor, a scriptwriter, a motion designer, a colorist and a sound designer work on your video at the same time. A reviewer scores every draft and sends weak ones back before you see them.

footage.title: Your raw footage, already edited
footage.description: Upload unedited clips and get a tight cut back. Pauses, stumbles and weaker takes come out, the cut lands on full sentences, and the story stays intact.

editor.title: A real editor when you want one
editor.description: Open any finished video as an editable timeline. Trim, re-cut from the transcript, grade, mix and add subtitles, with autosave and version history. The editor is an early preview.

brand.title: Your brand, applied everywhere
brand.description: Give ReelBolt a brand PDF or a design export and it builds a brand kit with your colors, fonts and tone. A shared brand library keeps every project consistent, and you approve each change.

voice.title: Narration in a voice you choose
voice.description: Narration is written to fit the cut and spoken in a stock voice, or in a cloned voice once the speaker has recorded their consent. Subtitles and captions come with it.

broll.title: B-roll on a budget you set
broll.description: Cutaways, cold opens and end cards are planned from your edit and generated under a spending cap you set. Each shot gets several takes and the best one is kept. On {plans}.
